name: Paai
source: A woman consumed by obsession, Pi will stake everything in pursuit of a perfection that does not exist. Like the number she is named after, her pursuit can only draw ever closer to its goal without ever reaching it. Her halo, a disc of three quarter-segments and a further 0.14 segment, echoes 3.14; the three lines extending from it mark out a prison of her own making. Her hair is infinitely long, and she disposes of the excess through a portal in the ground.
